detect_layout_sglang: detect the token layout (T or BS) from raw step data using the SGLang plugin
detect_layout_megatron: detect the token layout (T or BS) from raw step data using the Megatron plugin
compute_step_aux_sglang: compute step auxiliary data (input_ids, positions, seq_lens, seq_ids) from SGLang step data
compute_step_aux_megatron: compute step auxiliary data (input_ids, positions, seq_lens, seq_ids) from Megatron step data
infer_cp_sharded_dims: infer CP-sharded tensor dimension strings for a given tensor name and ndim
